shared_elements: boat/ship in profile with a row of short vertical strokes (crew lines)
repeated small strokes forming a row
curved hull line with upturned prow
figures shown alongside ships on an open rock surface
justification: Both surfaces appear to carry the same distinctive motif of a curved boat hull topped by a row of short parallel crew strokes, accompanied by small schematic stick-like human figures scattered across an unbounded rock face, which is a fairly specific and arbitrary combination. However, A shows a legible composition with clearly individuated figures (one with a large disc, one holding an object aloft, a discrete row of dots) whereas in B the motifs are worn, more crowded and vertically stacked, with no comparable large disc-figure or clear scenic grouping, so the correspondence stays at the level of motif type rather than a shared scene.
